recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add a generic enrollment reference SearchParameter for FHIR-25239; any remaining need for complex enrollment group include/search behavior should be handled as a separate profiled requirement or new work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-25239 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core ResearchStudy issue that asked for a SearchParameter on ResearchStudy.enrollment. The final resolution narrowed the action to adding simple-number queries for total enrollment counts while seeking more detail for more complex search needs.
initial_application: Commit 54d65efcc8a70d79c299324443b75d6609f2d826, whose message names #25239, added ResearchStudy recruitment actual and target number SearchParameters over ResearchStudy.recruitment.actualNumber and ResearchStudy.recruitment.targetNumber. It also included broader ResearchStudy edits and mentioned FHIR-31658, which is an unrelated CARIN IG issue.
additional_context: ResearchStudy is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source defines ResearchStudy.recruitment.targetNumber and ResearchStudy.recruitment.actualNumber as unsignedInt count elements and defines recruitment-target and recruitment-actual number SearchParameters over them. FHIR-40336 later renamed the originally applied underscore search parameter codes to hyphenated names for consistency without changing their semantics. The original Zulip thread shows the broader include/search motivation around enrollment groups, but no Confluence references or later community evidence changed the Jira disposition.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current core source already implements the approved simple-number search parameters and the later accepted naming cleanup is present.
